scenes.text: Can free markets solve everything, or do we need state care and toleration?
scenes.narration: Imagine a world where markets decide everything from your school fees to healthcare. Could that really bring freedom, or does society break down without shared care?

scenes.text: A school that cancels fee waivers and leaves every service to private market stalls.
scenes.narration: As an everyday analogy, imagine your school cancels all subsidized canteens and lets private vendors charge whatever they want. Wealthy students feast, while others cannot afford lunch!

scenes.heading: The Rise of Global Neoliberalism

events.what: Thatcherism rolls back Britain's welfare state
Reaganomics expands free market capitalism in USA
Washington Consensus spreads globally with the WTO

scenes.narration: When western welfare states ran fiscal deficits in the 1970s, leaders rolled them back. From Thatcher in Britain to Reagan in America, free-market policies soon spread across the globe.

scenes.name: Friedrich Hayek
scenes.idea: Market allocation resembles a central nervous system, making social justice a mirage.
scenes.narration: Thinkers like Hayek, Nozick, and Milton Friedman argued that freedom requires free markets. Hayek compared markets to a central nervous system, while Nozick defended a minimal night-watchman state.

scenes.heading: Neoliberalism versus Social Liberalism

columns.title: Social Liberalism
items: State, market, and civil society partnership

scenes.narration: Here's the twist: neoliberalism treats markets like god, but social liberals like Amartya Sen and Joseph Stiglitz pushed back. They urged state-backed capacity building and inclusive growth.

scenes.heading: The Liberal Principle of Toleration
items: Derived from Latin tolerare meaning to endure
Evolved from state neutrality to multiculturalism
scenes.narration: Liberalism also demands toleration, from the Latin tolerare, meaning to endure. It is the deliberate self-restraint to accept practices you dislike, protecting personal freedom in diverse societies.

items: Neoliberalism revived minimal state and market supremacy
Social liberalism champions capacity building and welfare
Toleration endures diversity through self-restraint and rights
scenes.narration: To recap: neoliberalism shrank the state for market freedom, social liberalism restored capacity building for equality, and toleration remains the substantive heart protecting our shared freedom.
